analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 54.6 maintains a neutral zone, showing an upward trend from 48.2 five days ago but still in the consolidation phase after exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram at 0.3239 continues to improve from -0.0479 five days ago, indicating a shift to bullish momentum. The 5-day low of $14.98 is higher than the 20-day low of $14.12, confirming a Higher Low pattern. The current price of $17.31 is above SMA5, SMA20, SMA50, and SMA100, but below SMA200. Weekly RSI is 51.0 and weekly MACD histogram is 0.3765, indicating no clear trend. ADX at 30.3 suggests a strong trend, with +DI at 35.8 significantly outperforming -DI at 8.0. CCI is at 133.6, entering overbought territory. Stochastic %K is 33.7 and %D is 50.5, signaling an impending dead cross. ATR at 9.80% indicates high volatility. The price is trading within the range of swing support at $17.15 and swing resistance at $17.59. The 52-week position is 17.9%.
